column2: Izincwadi ze-courier-ejensi + ideski lokubhuka. Mahhala okungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi.
Isikhundla sanamuhla. Ukubhuka = ​​amaphasela angenile. Khokha = izikweletu zenkampani yenethiwekhi nezindleko. Amaqembu = abathumeli nabathwali.
Amavawusha ezindleko kanye nezikweletu zenkampani yenethiwekhi (imali ekhishiwe). I-akhawunti ihlala encwadini yephathi.
Umazisi wephathi uhlukile (amagama angaphinda). Izindima: Umthumeli (AR), Inkampani Yenethiwekhi (AP), noma kokubili kuleyo ID. Ama-ledger ahlala ehlukene; imibiko ikhombisa inethi.
Indima yangokwezifiso (ongakukhetha) — noma thepha i-chip ngenhla
Ibhuku losuku, abakweletwayo nabakweletwayo, ileja yasebhange, amarisidi ezindleko, inzuzo nokulahlekelwa.
Umugqa ngamunye uyinani (isb. I-Surface Zone A). Iyunithi ngokuvamile i-kg. Thepha ukuze uhlele.
Awekho amanani okwamanje. Vula Amanani namasevisi, engeza eyodwa (igama + inani, iyunithi kg), bese Ubhukha.
Izithonjana ezifanayo njengesitimela esiseceleni. Hudula umugqa ukuze uhlele kabusha. Phenya iswishi ukuze ubonise noma ufihle. Izilungiselelo kanye Nokhiye kuhlala kubha.
Izinto zemenyu ozithengisa njalo, zilondolozelwe ukungena kwakho ngemvume. Engeza eyodwa kubhili yesivakashi, noma yakha uhlu lwakho kuzo zonke izinto zemenyu ezingezansi.
Azikho izintandokazi okwamanje — engeza izinto zemenyu ohlwini olungezansi.
Alikho ikhasimende okwamanje — thayipha igama, bese uthepha okuthi Ikhredithi
Khetha iphathi ozoyigcwalisa, noma shiya kungenalutho ukuze ungene. Iyadingeka ukuze kulandwe ekhaya kanye ne-RTO.
Umamukeli wephasela. Shiya kungenalutho ezindaweni zokwehla ezikhawulweni zokungena.

Umthumeli + othunyiwe (okungenalutho KULUNGILE) → indawo → kala → isilinganiso sokukhetha → I-akhawunti/Ukheshi → khokha. I-AWB iphrinta kurisidi. Ukubhukha okulandelayo kusula ideski. I-rounding iqala ilingana ne-Applied — hlela kuphela ukuzungeza ibhili.
Ideski alinalutho — umthumeli/umthumeli uyazikhethela, setha indawo oya kuyo nesisindo, cindezela okuthi ENGEZA inani, bese ukhokha.
Shintsha ukuvula PIN komuntu ongene ngemvume kule divayisi.
Uwena kuphela ongashintsha i-PIN yakho yokuvula (kanye nephasiwedi yokungena ozikhethela yona). Buza Umnikazi ukuthi udinga izikrini ezihlukile noma amalungelo.
Landela ulimi lwale divayisi, noma uzikhethele wena.
Vula iseva ekhona, noma udale enye ibhizinisi.

Iseva igcina amaleja lapha. Iklayenti libhangqa kuseva.

Imilayezo yesimo ihlala isikhathi esingakanani esikrinini kuwe (lokhu kungena ngemvume).

Amalogi ahlala kule divayisi. Izimfihlo (PIN, amagama ayimfihlo) azilokothi zigcinwe. Ukwabelana ngephakheji ocingweni kudinga imvume yakho ecacile njalo - akukaze kuthengiswe noma kunikezwe izinkampani zangaphandle.

Akukho okutholiwe. Kuseva: Izilungiselelo → Amanye amadivaysi → Vumela amarejista emali engeziwe (okufanayo Wi‑Fi). Noma thayipha i-IP eboniswe lapho.

Ayikho ikhophi eyisipele eshiye le divayisi izinsuku ezingu-{n} — Izilungiselelo → Isipele
Ikhophi eyisipele ayikwazanga ukulondolozwa lapho — khetha enye indawo

Thola amaphrinta wangempela, bese ukhetha Irisidi noma ilebula ye-AWB. Umsebenzi ngamunye unobubanzi bawo, isithombe noma ukuma kwezwe, nokuthi amabhayithi athunyelwa kanjani. Ilebula iphrinta ibhakhodi. Indawo engenalutho = ungaphrinti.
Ayikho iphrinta yalowo msebenzi — engeza eyodwa ngaphansi kwale ndawo
Amaphrinta asethwe kudivayisi yesitolo (Iseva). Lokhu kuze kuthumele imisebenzi lapho - Thola / engeza / yabela ukuhlala Kuseva. Ikhasi lokuhlola liya Kuseva.
Thepha okuthi Thola amaphrinta ukuze uthole olayini abamukela imisebenzi namaphrinta amarisidi enethiwekhi kule Wi-Fi (angakhishiwe noma angaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi).
Awekho amaphrinta atholiwe — thayipha igama lephrinta yesistimu, noma ikheli lenethiwekhi (isb. 192.168.1.50).
Asikho isipele sezinsuku ezingu-{n} — gcina uhlelo lokusebenza luvuliwe kule divayisi ukuze lukwazi ukwenza isipele.
Kuphela {mb} MB mahhala kule divayisi — izipele zizohluleka maduzane. Khulula isikhala.

Ongakukhetha. Uma le phinikhodi ibhalwe ekuvuleni esikhundleni seyakho, konke okufakiwe kwezincwadi kuyasulwa (ukubhuka, amaleja, umlando) futhi ideski livuleka njengomnikazi ebukeka evamile — amanani, amaqembu, izindawo, abasebenzi kanye nezilungiselelo zokuhlala. I-schema ne-config akususwa. Sebenzisa kuphela uma uphoqelekile ukuthi uvule. Shiya kungenalutho futhi ulondoloze ukuze uvale. Ayifani nephinikhodi yanoma ubani.

Kule divayisi (Iseva): Amanye amadivayisi → Vumela amathili engeziwe. Qaphela ikhodi yokumatanisa nekheli le-Wi-Fi. Thepha okuthi Vumela amanye amadivaysi ukuthi axhume uma evela. Kukhompyutha, thepha okuthi Qala ngale khompyutha. Edivayisini ngayinye: faka uhlelo lokusebenza, khetha Imodi Yeklayenti, Thola iseva yesitolo (noma thayipha ikheli), faka ikhodi yokumatanisa, Bhangqa manje. Ama-oda alinda kudivayisi uma i-Wi-Fi iwela bese iya lapho Iseva iphendula futhi.
Ukubuyisana kwebhange (maka uqhathanise nesitatimende sakho sasebhange)

Khetha indali ozoyichibiyela, uyichithe, noma uyibuyisele. Izichibiyelo zigcina umlando ogcwele. Ingqikithi Eyindingilizi iqala ilingana ne-Sebenzisiwe — hlela ukuzungeza kuphela. Ubuze nokubuyiselwa imali kungase kudinge Umnikazi noma Umphathi PIN (othayiphe ngenhla; kuqoshwe ngegama lakho).

Ukuthekelisa kubhala isifinyezo sosuku kufolda yezipele bese kusikopishela ebhodini lokunamathisela. Ukuze ungenise olunye usuku lwesitolo, londoloza ifayela layo njenge import_branch_snapshot.json kuleyo folda, bese uthepha okuthi Ngenisa.
Iboniswa ezikrinini ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza. Igama lohlelo lokusebenza olufakiwe nesithonjana kule divayisi kuhlala njengohlu lwenkundla.
Umaki wesitolo ozikhethela wona ezikrinini kuhlelo lokusebenza.
Ongakukhetha. Ngaphandle kwesithombe sibonisa amagama okuqala asuka egameni lento yemenyu.

Iphakethe lezwe lisetha igama lentela nezibalo, ujantshi okhokha ngokushesha, kanye ne-id yebhizinisi ephrintwe ezinkokhelweni zesivakashi. Kumkaj ayifaki izintela noma ikhiphe ama-invoyisi kahulumeni noma kuphi.

Okusha = ikhathalogi engenalutho (engeza izinto kamuva). Incwadi = thayipha isitoko sokuvula futhi ngubani okukweleta ngezansi.
Okusha okukhethiwe — ikhathalogi ihlala ingenalutho. Thepha okuthi Kwenziwe uma usulungile.
Kamuva: Izilungiselelo → sebenzisa iphekhi yezwe lakho ukuze uthole amalebula entela namalebula okukhokha.

Ukuthi amaphasela akalwa kanjani etafuleni lokubhuka. Thayipha ubukhulu nesisindo kumayunithi owasebenzisayo — okujwayelekile (cm, m, in, ft · kg, g, lb, oz) noma iyunithi yakho exhunywe ku-cm/kg ngenhla (ngqo noma ngamanye amayunithi). Izincwadi zihlala zirekhoda kg. Shiya inkambu ingenalutho ukuze uyigcine.
Thayipha ukuthi yimalini kunto ngayinye (ukheshi / i-UPI / ikhadi / isikweletu). Kumelwe ingezwe kubhili. Ikhredithi idinga ikhasimende ngenhla.
Ikhathalogu, ukuthengisa, isikweletu, iqembu, ikhophi yasenqolobaneni - kanye nesitoko namathili engeziwe lapho kudingeka.
Ukungena ngemvume ngokuzithandela (id + iphasiwedi). Umnikazi usetha kanye; umsebenzisi kuphela ongashintsha iphasiwedi kamuva.
Umthengisi: thengisa. Umphathi: thengisa + izinto zemenyu + ukuqeda/ukulungisa.
Lolu hlelo lokusebenza yi-Moklanjo kuphela - izincwadi + nedeski lokubhuka. Obunye ubuso bezohwebo buthunyelwa njengemikhiqizo ehlukene kamuva.
Buyisela: khetha ikhophi yasenqolobaneni. Amaleja avuleka njengoba ayenjalo ngaleso sikhathi; amaleja njengoba enjalo manje agcinwa kuqala, ngakho lokhu kungahlehliswa.

Umnikazi kuphela - ukukhetha okufanayo nokukhishwa kweWindows. Amarekhodi ebhizinisi asula umlando wokuhweba kodwa agcina amanani nokusetha (njengephinikhodi yokuvula izimo eziphuthumayo). Ukusethwa kwesitolo kususa isizindalwazi sezincwadi. Okuthandwayo kwesikrini kusula iwindi/ulimi. Qinisekisa ngephinikhodi yomnikazi. Iphinikhodi yokuvula izimo eziphuthumayo Eqenjini ihlukene (ukusula okuyimfihlo ekuvuleni).
Faka Umnikazi PIN ukuze ususe idatha yendawo.
Ukusethwa kwesitolo kusuliwe — khetha Iseva noma Iklayenti ukuze uqhubeke.
Thayipha igama lento yemenyu (ingxenye yayo yanele), inani, bese ulungisa. Izinto zemenyu ezingabaliwe okwamanje zidinga Qala ukulandelela kanye.

Qasha: khetha umsebenzi (I-Cashier / Manager), igama + i-PIN yokuqala, bese Ungeza. Kuphela uma lo muntu ehluka: vula izikrini namalungelo ngezansi, bese Londoloza ukusethwa komsebenzi. Wonke umuntu ushintsha i-PIN yakhe ngezansi — Umnikazi akakwazi ukushintsha eyomunye umuntu.

Amakhodi amalebula ento yemenyu (kg, ucezu, isikhwama). Yonke iyunithi kufanele ixhume — ngokuqondile noma ngamanye amayunithi — ezingeni (kg · cm · ml · pc), isb. Ikhreyithi elingu-1 = ibhokisi eli-2 nebhokisi elingu-1 = 20 cm. Ukuguqulwa: 1 kusuka = ​​isici kuya. Izimali aziwona amayunithi.
